summary: finding_close_86 does not prove its second And: the tampered reason-only body is staged as kind=finding/hand-written.json, so gate promote refuses it on the filename layout rule ('expected kind=finding/c1__0001__0001__<digest>.json ... found hand-written.json', reproduced), never reaching the transition/identity check; deleting that check leaves the test green.
